title: canDeactivate guard runs from top down to child routes
body:

**Current behavior**
<!-- Describe how the bug manifests. -->
- navigate from `/root/branch/1` to `/root/branch/2`, canDeactivate guard runs from top down to the child
- navigate from `/root/branch/1` to `/`, canDeactivate guard runs from child to the top (which is as documented)

**Expected behavior**
<!-- Describe what the behavior would be without the bug. -->
As [documented](https://angular.io/docs/ts/latest/guide/router.html#!#guards), it should always run from child to top.
>The router checks the CanDeactivate() and CanActivateChild() guards first, from the deepest child route to the top.
